scripts.build:wasm:opt: command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: wasm-opt not found on PATH. Install binaryen (macOS: brew install binaryen).' >&2; exit 1; }; test -f wasm/hyperion_core_bg.wasm || { echo 'ERROR: wasm/hyperion_core_bg.wasm not found. Run build:wasm first.' >&2; exit 1; }; wasm-opt -O3 --strip-debug --enable-simd wasm/hyperion_core_bg.wasm -o wasm/hyperion_core_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:release: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:opt
scripts.build:wasm:physics:release: npm run build:wasm:physics && wasm-opt -O3 --strip-debug --enable-simd wasm-physics/hyperion_core_bg.wasm -o wasm-physics/hyperion_core_bg.wasm
